data.body: Patchset 3 secondary CI RCA: Gerrit Verify run 31872498514 failed its unchanged default suite on Ubuntu 3.11 and 3.12 because the new held-out cleanup oracle launched nested pytest with cacheprovider enabled. Nested pytest inherited the checkout as root and created .pytest_cache; the outer full-suite command deliberately disables its own cacheprovider, so tests/conftest.py correctly reported a new REPO_ROOT entry. Local exact reproduction with outer -p no:cacheprovider was RED with that leak. Adding -p no:cacheprovider to the nested process returned GREEN; deleting the flag returned the exact RED, and restoring it returned GREEN again. Focused snapshot/repo-isolation coverage passed 18 tests, make lint including all-workflow actionlint and release zizmor passed, and patchset 4 run 31873067707 is active. This changes test hygiene only; selectors, assertions, workers, platforms, coverage, and behavioral scope remain unchanged. Patchset 3 was superseded and canceled within 76 seconds of patchset 4 creation.
